newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares break new record ground, Nycomed up.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares break new record ground, Nycomed up.

text.p: Norwegian shares cvontinued to press into new record territory on Friday although activity was lower than previous sessions this week due to the public holiday in the United States and the beginning of the summer vacation season in Norway.
After a late spurt, the Total share index closed 0.58 percent higher at the day's peak of 1237.74 points. Turnover was 940 million crowns.
Drugs group Nycomed ASA was again the most heavily traded share accounting for 227 million crowns of the day's total business.

Dealers said many shareholders were selling B shares for A stock, which hold voting rights. On Tuesday Nycomed said it planned to merge to with Britian's Amersham. Analysts say there appears to be little doubt the fusion will go ahead.
Nycomed As closed 1.50 crowns up at 144 crowns, while the Bs ended flat at 135.00 crowns.

Fodd and beverage-based conglomerate Orkla ASA rose four percent to 578 crowns in thin trade. Dealers attributed the rise to market rumours that the group could be close to a production agreement with PepsiCo following the termination of its deal with Coca Cola Co.
